title: North Karelia: 3.1 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €146,000 a year
markdown:
# North Karelia: 3.1 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €146,000 a year

> Closes 3.1 of 5.7 missing patients a year (54%) · €146,000 of €1.00M · €854,000 left: nothing else pays off at these assumptions

## The gap

Of 100 lung cancer patients in North Karelia, 21 get treatment that aims to cure. In Finland it is 27. That is about 6 patients a year. [^care_curative] Compared with the best quarter of counties, 9.1 patients a year are missing (range 5.3–12.7) [^model]. Compared with Finland as a whole, these missing patients split into 1.0 a year not operated and 4.7 a year not given radiotherapy that aims to cure; the share operated on its own is within the range chance allows [^model] [^care_surgery]. Patients in the KYS collaborative area do not wait longer: 29.4 days from diagnosis to first treatment, against 36.9 in Finland [^care_time_to_treatment]. Fewer are treated to cure [^care_curative].

## The target

Raise the share of lung cancer patients treated to cure from 21.4% to 24.4% by 2028: 3.1 more patients a year (range 0.0–4.2), for €146,000 a year, about €47,000 per extra patient. [^care_curative][^model] That closes 54% of the measured shortfall against Finland as a whole (5.7 patients a year). [^model]

## Funded actions

| # | Action and owner | Cost a year | More patients treated to cure a year (range) | First step this week | Measure: today → target |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | **The county can start on Monday** | | | | |
| 1 | **Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated**[^ev_sbrt_pathway_1]. Chief physician of oncology; chief of radiotherapy at the university hospital | €22,400 | 0.8 (0.0–1.6) | Write the referral rule: every stage I patient not accepted for surgery is referred for stereotactic radiotherapy the same week. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 21.4% → 22.2% by 2028 |
| 2 | **Travel and hotel paid for patients far from the university hospital**[^ev_travel_accommodation_support_1]. Chief physician of oncology and hospital social work; university hospital patient hotel | €31,600 | 0.3 (0.0–0.3) | Name one contact person who books the patient hotel and transport for every patient sent to the university hospital for curative treatment. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 21.4% → 21.7% by 2028 |
| | **Needs the collaborative area (university hospital)** | | | | |
| 3 | **A chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate**[^ev_surgeon_second_opinion_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; chief of thoracic surgery at the university hospital | €41,000 | 1.1 (0.0–1.1) | Agree with the university hospital that a thoracic surgeon joins the weekly lung meeting, and send last quarter's stage I-II patients who were not operated for a second look. | Share of patients operated: 13.9% → 14.9% by 2028 |
| 4 | **Weekly video review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital's specialists**[^ev_video_mdt_stage1_3_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; lead of the university hospital lung MDT | €51,000 | 0.9 (0.0–1.3) | Ask the university hospital for a fixed weekly video slot and list every stage I-III patient diagnosed last month who was not discussed there. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 21.4% → 22.3% by 2028 |
| | **Total** | **€146,000** | **3.1 (0.0–4.2)** | | |

No trial has measured these effects; the low end of every range is zero. The ranges do not add up to the range of the total, because the measures share one ceiling. Costs are assumptions. [^model]

## Needs a national decision (outside this budget)

- **Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers**[^ev_ldct_screening_1]: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko (decision), Finnish Cancer Registry (steering), county (delivery). €504,254 a year; modelled to avoid 0.9 deaths a year (0.2–2.2). Not counted in this budget. Not a county decision. Ask the Ministry and Palko for the timetable after the 2026-2028 pilot and offer the county as a pilot site. [^model]

## What to measure from Monday

- Share of patients treated to cure: 21.4% (2019–2023, measured) → 24.4% by 2028. [^care_curative][^model]
- Share of patients operated: 13.9% → 14.9% by 2028. [^care_surgery][^model]
- The registry's public figures cover 2019–2023; count these each month from the county's own records. [^care_curative]

## What more money buys, and what it cannot

€146,000 buys every measure that adds to this objective [^model]. In the model, the remaining €854,000 buys nothing more, because the reachable part of the shortfall limits the access measures, not money [^model]. Lung cancer causes about 81 deaths a year in North Karelia, and this plan is modelled to avoid 0.5 of them (range 0.0–1.2) [^deaths] [^model].

## Pilot ask

Six months with North Karelia and its university hospital: ask what already runs, check 50 charts, then run the two actions that decide who is treated, for the part that is missing. In week 1, take the stored web-check questions to the university hospital. In weeks 1–8 spend €8,000 auditing 50 charts for stage, fitness, biomarker testing, why curative treatment was not given and where treatment happened. In months 3–6, run those two for what the hospital confirms is missing. Success is counted in charts audited, decisions reviewed, decisions changed and referrals made; patients moved are a secondary model estimate. [^model]

## Limits

- Each effect is given as a range, not a probability [^model]. The range runs from all assumed effect sizes at their lowest to all at their highest [^model].
- The expected share is adjusted only for residents' age, not for stage at diagnosis, other illness, smoking or recording completeness [^model]. County figures cannot show cause [^model].
- In a check, 0 of 3 measured outcomes matched the estimated symptom-to-treatment clock beyond chance [^model].

flagged.sentence: Compared with Finland as a whole, 1.0 fewer are operated and 4.7 fewer get radiotherapy that aims to cure each year [^model].
flagged.reason: This is an arithmetic split of the shortfall. The share operated (13.9% vs 14.9%) is within the range chance allows, so 'fewer are operated' implied a gap that is not shown. Rewritten as a split and noted as within chance.

flagged.sentence: The remaining €854,000 buys nothing more, because the reachable part of the shortfall limits the access measures, not money [^model].
flagged.reason: This is a model result stated as fact. Added 'In the model', as in the source.

pilot.comparison_en: Vantaa and Kerava is the comparison because it has Finland's highest recorded curative share (35.6%): a reachable level, not a causal control.
pilot.comparison_fi: Vantaa ja Kerava on vertailu, koska siellä kirjattu parantavan hoidon osuus on Suomen korkein (35,6 %): tavoiteltava taso, ei kausaalinen verrokki.
pilot.targets_en: Start the two actions that decide who is treated: a chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate, and every patient who cannot be operated is referred for precise radiotherapy.
pilot.targets_fi: Käynnistetään ne kaksi toimea, jotka ratkaisevat, kuka saa parantavaa hoitoa: thoraxkirurgi arvioi jokaisen päätöksen jättää leikkaamatta, ja jokainen potilas, jota ei voida leikata, lähetetään täsmäsädehoidon arvioon.
pilot.text_en: Six months with North Karelia and its university hospital: ask what already runs, check 50 charts, then run the two actions that decide who is treated, for the part that is missing. In week 1, take the stored web-check questions to the university hospital. In weeks 1–8 spend €8,000 auditing 50 charts for stage, fitness, biomarker testing, why curative treatment was not given and where treatment happened. In months 3–6, run those two for what the hospital confirms is missing. Success is counted in charts audited, decisions reviewed, decisions changed and referrals made; patients moved are a secondary model estimate.
pilot.text_fi: Kuusi kuukautta Pohjois-Karjalan hyvinvointialueen ja sen yliopistosairaalan kanssa: kysytään, mikä on jo käytössä, tarkistetaan 50 potilaskertomusta ja tehdään kahdesta hoitopäätöksen ratkaisevasta toimesta se osa, joka puuttuu. Viikolla 1 viedään tallennetuista verkkotarkistuksista saadut kysymykset yliopistosairaalaan. Viikoilla 1–8 käytetään 8 000 euroa 50 potilaskertomuksen tarkistukseen: levinneisyysaste, toimintakyky, biomarkkerit, miksi parantavaa hoitoa ei annettu ja missä hoito annettiin. Kuukausina 3–6 tehdään näistä kahdesta se, minkä sairaala vahvistaa puuttuvan. Onnistuminen lasketaan tarkistetuista kertomuksista, arvioiduista päätöksistä, muuttuneista päätöksistä ja lähetteistä; potilassiirtymät ovat toissijainen malliarvio.

no_surgery_decisions_reviewed.basis_en: 44 patients are not operated in six months. Stage is not published by county; with Finland's stage mix (59% found at stage IV) about 14 of them have cancer that has not spread to other organs. Those are the decisions reviewed. The chart audit gives the county's own number.

pilot.cannot_show_en: 23.2% is the model's estimate for these two actions by 2028, not a measurement. The pilot is judged on the work counted, not on a promised change in the county's share.
pilot.cannot_show_fi: 23,2 % on mallin arvio näistä kahdesta toimesta vuoteen 2028 mennessä, ei mittaus. Pilottia arvioidaan lasketun työn perusteella, ei luvatun osuuden muutoksen perusteella.
